column1: # Slice 297 (CALLABLE-PLACE-NAMED-RECEPTION, REPEATED-DECL-TYPED-RECEPTION), try a04: the files of a03 with the U spelling
# kept -- registry r297a on fe159b/rt159a failed unary_complement native (gdb: `~0U`, a contextual literal, took the size_t
# complement without its U spelling and was received as -1, no unsigned): the kernel's lmx_walk_value_unary negates and
# complements a U-spelled contextual literal in its C99 unsigned type and keeps the spelling, lmx_walk_value_lit_fits reads a
# U-spelled literal as its magnitude, and the three emitters of a negated contextual literal negate one spelled U in its own
# type (`0U - n`) and one of no U spelling as the size_t two's complement; one comment of lower corrected (it named
# lm_compiler_emit_dyn_values_full for lm_compiler_emit_dyn_operand_full) -- the candidate stage cold-tp140 with the eight
# changed files of the working copy (kernel lmx_walk_values, frontend lower and emit, the fixture named_actuals_selected,
# var_own_repeat_receive and var_own_repeat_norecv_refused, which replace slice 295's var_own_nested_type_refused; their
# registry rows and inputs), run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot158a: the
# changed files pinned, kept in variants/tp159 and copied into the stage; the source manifest of the stage by the inputs list
# (235 inputs) written, then checked against the working copy -- the stage equals selfbuild on every input.
